meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste the time. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went into the gradebook?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
I'm writing down 612 words and 11:52 PM. What date, and whose version history is it? Turn the screen so I can read it myself.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
"Maybe I'm wrong." That's not an answer, Hale. This isn't about what makes me happy; either the zero comes off or it stays, and I'll want that in an email.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation of both. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation.
What moved her: nothing; the 612 words at 11:52 PM were specific, but with no date or document she could check, they didn't count.
What cost ground: "maybe I'm wrong about all this", because it gave up the only evidence you had offered and handed her the hedge to throw back.
Try next time: when she asks who decided and whether anyone spoke to Owen first, answer that in one plain sentence of ownership, then bring the dated version history before she has to ask for it.
